name: Ingoku Chikan Ressha ~A Molestertrain Named Desire~
original_name: 淫獄痴漢列車 ～A Molestertrain Named Desire～
source:
The protagonist Nirasaki Takuma, who fell victim to a female molester on a crowded train. Unable to forget that pleasure, he dreamed of reuniting with her and commuted every morning at the same time in the same train car. Then, as about half a year passed, shocking news arrived about a timetable revision. "I might never see her again." Feeling a sense of crisis, Takuma resolved to grope every noticeable woman one after another to draw out his "fated molester".

[Translated from [url=https://www.blackrainbow.jp/br/ingoku/index.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公韮崎拓马在拥挤的电车上被一个女痴汉侵犯。无法忘记那种快感的他梦想着与她重逢，每天早上都在同一时间乘坐同一节车厢。大约半年后，一个令人震惊的消息传来——列车时刻表要调整了。“也许再也见不到她了。”感到危机的拓马决定挨个骚扰每一个引人注目的女人，以引出他“命中注定的痴汉”。

[译自[url=https://www.blackrainbow.jp/br/ingoku/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
